title: Kit Green could not get read into the autopsy program
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Kit Green could not get read into the autopsy program, about c. 2000s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Well, the story I heard was that Kit Green basically had been read in on most of it, but he couldn't get read in on the the autopsy thing

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron says he heard that Kit Green, a scientist connected to the CIA, had been "read in," meaning given secret access, to most of a hidden UFO program in the 2000s. But according to Cameron's story, Green could not get access to one part: the program examining bodies, which he calls the autopsy part. If true, it would mean a secret program existed with layers walled off even from insiders.
